name: Bboy Blaze – Private Breaking Coach
description:
Beginner-friendly Breaking classes in Mumbai for kids, teens, and adults.

Learn Breaking through safe, step-by-step training focused on confidence, creativity, fitness, coordination, and self-expression.

owner_posts.post_text:
From zero experience to a full breaking round in just one month. 🔥

Many people think they're too old or inexperienced to start breaking. This student's progress shows what consistent training and strong fundamentals can achieve.

Beginner-friendly breaking classes available in Mumbai.

📍 Mumbai

Are you looking for an activity that actually builds real-world discipline, core strength, and focus in your child? 🧠👟

Most youth activities focus on rigid choreography loops. 
My Breaking program is built completely on physics-based movement mechanics, giving kids explosive agility, gymnastics-level body control, and the confidence to perform under pressure.

From rock-solid baby freezes to headstands, I bridge elite athletic training with 100% safe, step-by-step progressions. Everything is personally trained and supervised by me.

📍 Private coaching batches are currently open for enrollment  Mumbai.

Moments like these are about more than just dance.

Breaking teaches confidence, creativity, courage, and self-expression.

Huge respect to everyone who participated at Rise of Breakers Mumbai 🔥

Bgirl Mary vs Bboy Ansh

Want to master a perfect tripod headstand safely? You don't need elite core strength—you just need the right physics. 🧠🤸‍♂️

Check out this quick 34-second tutorial breakdown to learn how to lock your foundation, align your hands correctly, and protect your spine from injury.

We provide personalized dance fitness training at client locations across Mumbai and Suburban including Kurla, Bandra, Andheri, Thane and Navi Mumbai.

Whether you want to lose weight, learn Bollywood dance, prepare for a Sangeet performance or improve your confidence, our sessions are designed to give real results.

Call now to book your 1on1 personal dance fitness session in Mumbai.

description:
At Mansvi Dance Academy, we believe that dance is the purest form of expression — a language that speaks through rhythm, grace, and movement. Our academy offers professional training in a wide range of dance styles, from classical to contemporary, Bollywood to hip-hop, helping students discover their talent and build confidence on and off the stage.

With experienced instructors, a supportive atmosphere, and performance opportunities throughout the year, Mansvi Dance Academy is the perfect place for dancers of all ages to learn, grow, and shine. Whether you dream of performing professionally or simply want to dance for joy — your journey starts here.

Dance. Dream. Discover.
Only at Mansvi Dance Academy.
